agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): cached procedures/mechanisms only pay off when re-derivation cost and recurrence are both non-trivial, so amortization questions must be answered with measured denominators, not assumed ones.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): when a benchmark's cold/retrieval baselines saturate at the success ceiling, a treatment arm cannot demonstrate an advantage, so dynamic range is a prerequisite for any economics test.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): small CPU-quantized local models frequently fail structured tool-use / JSON-action tasks, and supplying the goal schema plus few-shot structure can materially shift success, so a capability ceiling must be measured before paying for a multi-arm comparison.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a lane that repeatedly returns MEASUREMENT_INVALID on the same prerequisite is signaling that the prerequisite should be repaired once centrally (control plane / substrate / task bank) rather than re-probed per lane.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): promoting a capability through an audited, gated path (rather than bypassing it by manual copy) reduces the risk that later evidence is invalidated, so the shipped-carrier gate should precede the flagship benchmark.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): long-horizon autonomous factories drift toward local attractors (familiar substrate, familiar metric), so depth must be periodically checked against the whole problem by an explicit cognitive reset.

The active PREFREEZE mandate correctly supersedes that with the promotion task, using the sanctioned promotion workflow rather than manual copy, so it is the highest-leverage and least-duplicative next step.
